scope.timeUnits: integer minutes; intervals half-open; date inputs carry UTC offset

ruleRegister.description: Overtime for covered, nonexempt staff starts after 40 worked hours in the employer's fixed workweek.
ruleRegister.applicability: Fixture assumes FLSA coverage and nonexempt status for everyone.
ruleRegister.limits: This calculates overtime minutes, not wages. Overtime is not a legal maximum on hours.

ruleRegister.description: Time not worked on paid leave does not increase hours worked for federal overtime. Only duty-free bona fide meals are subtracted.
ruleRegister.applicability: Paid absence and fully relieved meal intervals in this fixture.
ruleRegister.limits: A missed meal or work during a break changes actual payable hours and requires payroll review.

ruleRegister.description: Paid holidays, sick leave and vacation do not count as hours worked for federal overtime.
ruleRegister.applicability: Preapproved paid absence recorded separately from worked time.
ruleRegister.limits: Other applicable benefit obligations not inferred from general federal guidance.

ruleRegister.description: Preserve the designated 24-hour rest window for each scheduled mercantile worker.
ruleRegister.applicability: Assumed covered staff where establishment operates Sunday; designated windows already recorded.
ruleRegister.limits: No exception, variance or new worker notice modeled. Do not treat this as weekly legal certification.

ruleRegister.description: For ordinary nonfactory shifts longer than six hours covering the noon window, require 30 uninterrupted minutes during 11:00–14:00.
ruleRegister.applicability: Only clearly covered daytime shifts in the modeled work patterns.
ruleRegister.limits: No short-meal permit, waiver, or borderline shift interpretation.

ruleRegister.description: For shifts starting before 11:00 and ending after 19:00, require an additional 20 minutes during 17:00–19:00.
ruleRegister.applicability: Ordinary mercantile shifts spanning both periods; fixture treats the dinner relief as paid.
ruleRegister.limits: No short-meal permit or waiver. Paid treatment in this case is explicit company accounting policy.

ruleRegister.description: Require 45 uninterrupted minutes around the midpoint for modeled nonfactory shifts longer than six hours starting after 13:00.
ruleRegister.applicability: Sample late shifts start at 14:00 and end the same day.
ruleRegister.limits: The statute also addresses qualifying shifts starting through 06:00. No overnight or night-shift cases are modeled.

ruleRegister.description: Honor the already-approved protected paid leave block.
ruleRegister.applicability: Model assumes fictional private employer with 128 employees and uses approved blocks only; state rules for employers with 100 or more include up to 56 paid hours per calendar year.
ruleRegister.limits: May not establish entitlement, require diagnosis, compute balance, or decide leave eligibility; those decisions stay outside the plan.

ruleRegister.description: Miscellaneous Industries Wage Order is a payroll implementation reference.
ruleRegister.applicability: Input scope assumes applicable Albany-area retail work under the miscellaneous order.
ruleRegister.limits: The solver does not calculate wage rates, premium interactions, spread-of-hours, call-in pay or payroll. Company fixture allows one shift/day and no schedule over 10 hours/day.

ruleRegister.description: Thanksgiving Day is November 26 in 2026.
ruleRegister.applicability: U.S. federal public holiday calendar and separate NY public holiday statute.
ruleRegister.limits: The calendar does not establish private closure or holiday premiums. SITE-A closure and SITE-B limited hours are company inputs.

ruleRegister.description: SITE-A closes on Thanksgiving. SITE-B opens 09:00–17:00 for selected short inventory and pickup operations.
ruleRegister.applicability: Fixture company retail operating-hours policy only.
ruleRegister.limits: This is not a government closure or holiday-pay mandate.

ruleRegister.description: Accepted vacation blocks are unavailable for scheduling.
ruleRegister.applicability: Approved company PTO windows; limited data disclosed.
ruleRegister.limits: No statutory vacation accrual or carryover rules modeled.

ruleRegister.description: Only staff with the requested training code hold that role.
ruleRegister.applicability: Keyholders, checkout, pickup, floor, and stock training tags.
ruleRegister.limits: Training is a known roster fact, not a worker assessment.

ruleRegister.description: Staff must be on the pre-cleared site roster.
ruleRegister.applicability: Cross-store workers have an explicitly allowed site; otherwise flagged.
ruleRegister.limits: Does not assess legal work authorization or eligibility.

ruleRegister.description: Work must fit reported time availability. Operational unavailability is a hard block.
ruleRegister.applicability: Horizon and disruption input only; no leave reason is inferred.
ruleRegister.limits: No prediction of future availability; no schedule writes.

ruleRegister.description: Only one shift per day per worker in this case.
ruleRegister.applicability: Avoids split shifts in the bounded fixture.
ruleRegister.limits: Not asserted as state or federal law.

ruleRegister.description: A planned break needs a pre-cleared relief resource reference so it can be duty-free.
ruleRegister.applicability: Relief references represent operations-confirmed spare capacity, outside this scheduler's resource pool.
ruleRegister.limits: Does not optimize or validate the relief resource roster; supervisors confirm actual release.

ruleRegister.description: Keep confirmed appointments and flag any newly invalid locked input for a supervisor.
ruleRegister.applicability: Imported immutable staffing commitments.
ruleRegister.limits: A closure or unavailability can require a refreshed roster; do not silently change the lock.

ruleRegister.description: Baseline selects the first permitted named worker without comparing overtime.
ruleRegister.applicability: Comparison baseline only.
ruleRegister.limits: This policy does not describe a real employer or claim a measured improvement.

ruleRegister.description: Cover as many shifts as possible, then minimize new overtime, then keep prior assignments where possible.
ruleRegister.applicability: Includes contracted objectives for the fictional operation.
ruleRegister.limits: Overtime remains permissible and counted; no salary, cost, candidate quality, or hiring decisions.
